input.overview: Shoot the flashing left Capture kicker to hold the first ball; this lights both the center Hole for another capture and the right Launch kicker. You may shoot the center Hole for a second lock, then shoot the flashing right Escape/Launch kicker to release everything and start three-ball Multiball. Starting after only the first capture gives two-ball Multiball.
input.simpleOverview: Shoot the flashing left Capture kicker to lock a ball. For three balls, shoot the now-flashing center Hole to capture another ball. Then shoot the flashing right Escape/Launch kicker to release the locks and start Multiball; you can take it after one capture for two balls.
input.summary: Capture one ball at the flashing left kicker, optionally capture a second at the flashing center Hole, then shoot the flashing right Escape/Launch kicker. One capture starts two-ball Multiball; two captures start three-ball Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Capture Ball 1
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the flashing left Capture kicker.

quickInfo.name: Capture Ball 2
quickInfo.summary: For three-ball play, shoot the center Hole while Capture is flashing.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the right Escape/Launch kicker while it is flashing.

quickInfo.name: Advance Multiplier
quickInfo.summary: Keep scoring switches to break down the wall; the threshold is lower during Multiball.

steps.text: Shoot the left kicker while Capture is flashing to hold the first ball.
If you want three-ball Multiball, shoot the center Hole while Capture is flashing to hold a second ball.
Shoot the right kicker while Escape or Launch is flashing to release the captures and start Multiball.
During Multiball, keep the balls moving through switches to break the wall and advance the playfield multiplier more quickly.

alternatives.title: Start with one capture
alternatives.when: Use this when the center Hole is dangerous or the current ball is valuable.

steps.text: After the left Capture kicker holds one ball, skip the optional center Hole.
Shoot the flashing right Escape/Launch kicker immediately for two-ball Multiball.
Complete the flashing J-A-I-L-B-R-E-A-K letters to light the top-center Special rollover.
Complete Cell Blocks 1 through 4 to light an Extra Ball rollover; Last Chance can release a captured ball at an outlane when lit.

machineSetup: Confirm three- versus five-ball rules, extra-ball conversion, switch thresholds for multiplier advances, and lock sharing.
Test both kickers, center capture Hole, captive-ball releases, Last Chance outlanes, J-A-I-L-B-R-E-A-K targets, and all four Cell Blocks.

playfieldReferences.label: Left Capture kicker
playfieldReferences.description: The first physical capture and the shot that enables Launch.

playfieldReferences.label: Center capture Hole
playfieldReferences.description: The optional second capture used for three-ball Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Escape / Launch kicker
playfieldReferences.description: The right-side shot that releases captured balls and starts Multiball.

cautions.response: Do not wait for three balls when survival matters; the flashing Escape/Launch kicker can start Multiball after the first capture.
